# `silk/platform/native/time_zone`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Direct reads of the time zone files and settings of a Unix system, for the native zone
providers.

## When to use
`silk.time.zones_native` uses `NativeTimeZone`. Application code uses those providers
through the `TimeZones` and `LocalZone` effects, so a test can replace them.

## Details
Zone files are looked for in the directory that the variable `TZDIR` names, then in
`/usr/share/zoneinfo`, `/var/db/timezone/zoneinfo`, `/usr/lib/zoneinfo`,
`/usr/share/lib/zoneinfo`, and `/etc/zoneinfo`. The first directory that has the file wins.

The local zone is the value of the variable `TZ`, or the zone that the link `/etc/localtime`
points to, or the first line of `/etc/timezone`.

## Gotchas
- The names are not checked here. The caller must check a name with `TimeZones.isValidName`
  before it reads a file, so that a name cannot leave the zone directory.
- This module exists on Darwin x86_64 or aarch64 and on GNU Linux x86_64 or aarch64.
